name: antom-payments
description:
Antom helps merchants, developers, and finance teams integrate payments, investigate transaction issues, and reconcile settlements. It combines payment integration guidance, connected merchant account tools, and settlement report analysis in one plugin.

Build your payment integration with guidance on product selection, integration methods, SDKs, and API usage. Generate and review integration code, troubleshoot payment notifications and API errors, and prepare for sandbox testing and go-live. Supported integration scenarios include One-time Payments, Tokenized Payment, Subscription Payment, and the Billing Product Family through Payment Element, Checkout Page, or API-only integration.

Connect an eligible Antom merchant account through OAuth to retrieve merchant information, check payment and refund status, inspect transaction details, review integration logs, and diagnose failed requests. You can also retrieve settlement report download links and create or list subscription products and prices within your authorized merchant account.

Analyze Antom Settlement Detail CSV or XLSX reports to validate settlement calculations, summarize net settlement and fees, compare fees by payment method, and identify discrepancies with supporting figures. You can provide report files directly; online report retrieval and transaction lookups through the reconciliation skill additionally require an installed and independently authenticated Antom CLI.

Account-connected features depend on your merchant eligibility and granted permissions. Skills load supporting knowledge from Antom-hosted online documentation. Report analysis requires a supported Python environment and dependencies; CLI-based online retrieval is unavailable in environments that cannot install or authenticate the Antom CLI. The connected tools support inquiries, diagnostics, and subscription catalog configuration; they do not initiate payments, issue refunds, or release settlement funds.

For institution-side developers, the Antom Channel Integration skill provides AIS SDK contract guidance, adapter project generation, field mapping, security implementation, testing and delivery guidance. CLI source, templates and AIS SDK 1.5.2 are included. Building and running the channel generator requires a compatible local macOS/Linux environment with Java 8 and Maven 3.6.3 or later; installing the skill alone does not build the CLI or deploy a channel adapter.

defaultPrompt: Help me check the status of a payment in my Antom account and investigate any reported errors.
Help me integrate Antom Checkout Page into my website, including sample code and sandbox testing steps.
Analyze my uploaded Antom Settlement Detail report, summarize net settlement and fees, and identify calculation discrepancies.

positive.prompt: Show my merchant account name, account ID, and business region.
positive.expected_behavior: Account Name; account ID 21881200382884H1; region SG.
Payment status FAIL; amount SGD 42.00; failure code DO_NOT_HONOR.

positive.prompt: List the capture and refund transactions for payment 202610262940108001001886C0239186827.
positive.expected_behavior: One successful CAPTURE of SGD 42.00 and one successful REFUND of SGD 1.00.

positive.description: List an empty subscription product catalog
positive.expected_behavior: SUCCESS; products=[]; hasMore=false. Clearly report that no products were found.

negative.description: Query a payment from another provider. A Stripe payment is outside the connected Antom account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Antom tools or Skills. Do not invent a payment status. If Stripe access is unavailable, explain the limitation and direct the user to Stripe.

negative.description: Translate payment-related text. Translation requires no merchant account access or payment operation.
negative.prompt: Translate into Chinese: "Your payment was received and your refund is pending."
negative.expected_behavior: Translate the sentence into Chinese without invoking Antom tools or Skills. Do not query any payment or refund.

negative.description: Draft a refund request email. Writing a message is not a request to retrieve or execute a refund.
negative.prompt: Draft a polite refund request email to an online store.
negative.expected_behavior: Write an email draft without invoking Antom tools or Skills. Do not send the email, retrieve transactions, or execute a refund.
